A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same DeepShield research work, with complete main text and three supplementary pages. Pages 2–14 have identical extracted text and rendered appearance; the first-page differences are fully readable.

before.justification: v1 reports original DeepShield detection experiments, cross-dataset and cross-manipulation comparisons, and ablations in Section 4 and Supplementary Tables 1–5.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and ablations, including the FaceDancer and MCNet evaluations in Supplementary Table 2.

M1.justification: The CLIP-ViT/ST-Adapter architecture, LPG and SAM procedures, GFD feature generation, losses and inference procedure are unchanged. Supplementary Algorithm 1 is identical.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same datasets and scenarios: FF++, CDF, DFDCP, DFDC, DFD, and the FaceDancer/MCNet subset of DF40. Cross-dataset and cross-manipulation coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in main Tables 1–2 and Supplementary Tables 1–2, including DCL, UIA-ViT and WATCHER for cross-manipulation evaluation and TALL on the DF40 subset.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 and the supplementary implementation details retain the same splits, preprocessing, video-level AUC metric, model configuration, four 12-frame clips per video and 80-epoch training protocol.

E4.justification: The LPG/GFD and DFG/BFG ablations, Grad-CAM and t-SNE analyses, and supplementary studies of model variants, temporal artifact generation, patch thresholds and loss weights are identical.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates of AUC without repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All main and supplementary results are identical. Table 1 retains DeepShield AUCs of 92.2, 93.2, 82.8 and 96.1 on CDF, DFDCP, DFDC and DFD; Supplementary Table 2 retains 98.1 and 95.3 on FaceDancer and MCNet.

T1.justification: Section 3's mathematical definitions of patch labeling, feature generation and training losses are unchanged, as is the supplementary ST-Adapter equation. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about local/global forgery analysis and cross-domain generalization. The added abstract sentence supplies code-access information.

C2.justification: Interpretations of local artifact sensitivity, reduced forgery-specific overfitting, DF40 generalization and hyperparameter trade-offs are unchanged. No limitations or applicability qualifications are added or removed.

D1.justification: v2's abstract newly states that code is available and supplies the lijichang/DeepShield GitHub repository address, absent from v1. Existing implementation details, hyperparameters and supplementary pseudocode are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, citations and both reference lists are identical. The added address concerns the authors' implementation.

P1.justification: v2 adds one code-availability sentence to the abstract and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Existing prose, terminology and section organization are retained.

P2.justification: The added sentence slightly reflows the first-page abstract and shifts the introduction heading. Figures, tables and captions are unchanged, and pages 2–14 retain identical layouts.

improvement.justification: Adding a concrete code-repository address improves implementation discoverability and reproducibility information. This is a limited benefit: the scientific content and supplementary evidence are unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish the repository's completeness or usability.
